Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The truck no-zone diagram on physical page one hundred fifty extracted only its labels, including two distance figures with no surrounding text, so those figures are not taught (verify NJ-SHARE-D-DIAGRAM).
Physical page one hundred forty-eight repeats a stray line about watching for pedestrians in driveways above the Safe Passing list; it is treated as a layout artifact and the list is reported as printed [A03].
The Safe Passing Law is described on two pages with the same distances and speed; both are kept with their own citations rather than merged.
The chapter opener and section contents pages carry only titles and page numbers and are not used.
